checks.detail: Launch a minimal native Godot prototype with a simple bounded placeholder room, a player camera and ordinary keyboard/mouse input. This is an intentionally rough first increment: do not import the authored FPS map, real weapon or hand assets, HUD package, minimap package, enemy package or decorative asset collection. Verify the game starts without a black screen, missing-resource error or direct dependency on final content.

Use ordinary input to look and move the placeholder player inside the bounded prototype. Require stable camera framing, a visible floor, predictable input capture/release and a deterministic restart state. Placeholder geometry is permitted and expected; production scale, authored landmarks, weapons, HUD and map quality are explicitly out of scope.

Issue one narrow bootstrap verdict for the launchable placeholder loop. Accept only a real runnable shell and basic camera/input evidence; do not expand this first phase into map import, weapon implementation, HUD, minimap, enemy AI or final presentation.

Pass. Candidate source and fresh runtime evidence agree on a 1.8 m CharacterBody3D capsule, 1.52 m world eye datum, grounded collision, camera-relative movement, 4.5/7.2/2.4 m/s walk/sprint/crouch targets, grounded-only jump, airborne descent and landing, coherent crouch collision/camera changes, F6 reset, and a collision-backed route to a real Alpha Area3D. Ordinary physical-key input exercised sprint, jump, a rejected second airborne jump, landing, crouch, route traversal, F6, and non-resetting R; runtime and editor logs were clean. The restrained cyan/amber orientation language, neutral exposure, and first-person scale align directionally with the PRD image while the intentionally rough primitive room correctly omits deferred map, weapon, HUD, minimap, enemy, and production-asset surfaces.

Fail. Ordinary locomotion reaches the identifiable Alpha placeholder, but main.tscn binds only an Area3D, CollisionShape3D, pad, posts, and label. No body_entered/body_exited signal, authoritative objective owner, transition state, completion rule, or event trace exists, and PrototypePlayer._mcp_state exposes locomotion only. Therefore entering or leaving Alpha cannot record the required authoritative transition.

Issue one integrated placeholder movement verdict. Preserve the intentionally rough blockout and advance once the input, ground contact, collision and placeholder objective are coherent; do not hold the entire project here for later visual quality debt.

required_criteria.requirement: Extend the placeholder prototype with human-scale CharacterBody3D movement, ground contact, collision, sprint/crouch where available, a simple route and a placeholder Alpha interaction volume. Keep the world intentionally small and rough. The complete authored map, real weapons/hands, production props, HUD and minimap must not be imported in this phase.

Through ordinary input, enter and leave the placeholder Alpha volume and record one authoritative objective transition. Require movement, collision and objective state to agree; labels or scripted teleportation are insufficient. This phase proves the player loop before any final map or combat asset intake.
